items.prompt:
Which is one of Earth's resources that people protect?
A) Clean water
B) Video games
C) Homework
D) Television shows

steps: Clean water is a natural resource people depend on.

items.prompt:
Recycling helps the environment because it
A) uses more new materials
B) reuses materials so fewer new resources are needed
C) makes more trash
D) pollutes water
items.answer: B) reuses materials so fewer new resources are needed

steps: Recycling reduces the need for raw materials and cuts waste.

items.prompt:
One way to reduce air pollution from cars is to
A) drive alone more
B) carpool or use public transit
C) idle the engine longer
D) use more fuel
items.answer: B) carpool or use public transit

steps: Burning less fuel means less air pollution.

items.prompt:
Communities need to protect resources because human activities can
A) create new oceans
B) use them up or pollute them
C) make them unlimited
D) do nothing to them
items.answer: B) use them up or pollute them

steps: Resources are limited and can be harmed.

items.prompt:
Planting trees helps protect the environment by
A) cleaning air, holding soil, and giving habitat
B) using up all the water
C) making more pollution
D) removing all animals
items.answer: A) cleaning air, holding soil, and giving habitat

steps: Trees protect air, soil, and living things at once.

items.prompt:
Why gather information from several sources when making an environmental plan?
A) It wastes time
B) It gives a fuller and more reliable picture
C) One source is always wrong
D) It hides information
items.answer: B) It gives a fuller and more reliable picture

steps: Combining sources is more complete and trustworthy.

items.prompt:
A community wants to protect a local river. The BEST plan is to
A) dump waste into it to test it
B) reduce pollution and plant trees along the bank
C) ignore it
D) drain the river
items.answer: B) reduce pollution and plant trees along the bank

steps: Cutting pollution and adding streamside trees protect the water and soil.

items.prompt:
Saving water is important because
A) there is unlimited easy-to-use freshwater
B) usable freshwater is rare, so it must be conserved
C) all water is fresh
D) water cannot be polluted
items.answer: B) usable freshwater is rare, so it must be conserved

steps: Easy-to-use freshwater is a small share of Earth's water, so conserving it matters.
